//! The string-free core of the spine: the ledger a scenario keeps of its
//! checks, and the script interpreter's scheduler. `suite-spine` re-exports
//! both modules and holds the text. Verus proves every item here
//! (`proof:spine`).
#![cfg_attr(not(test), no_std)]
use vstd::prelude::*;

pub mod ledger;
pub mod sched;

verus! {

/// Why a scenario refused a command.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Reject {
    AlreadyStarted,
    NotStarted,
    NotInFlight,
    Finished,
    /// A decision would hold more events than it has room for.
    Overflow,
}

} // verus!
